card.name: Words leading into 'small' or 'insignificant' effects
card.fires_on: Linking words just before a phrase that says an effect or risk is small, mild or negligible. Seen after percentage changes in drug-interaction text and in reassurance about overhead or risk.

card.writes: It favors words like easily, effortlessly and 'without any', and disfavors hedges like somewhat and relatively.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say an effect is minor or easily handled.
